about_the_game:
Feral Echoes is an exciting survival adventure where every step counts. The game combines elements of survival, exploration, magic, and combat. Explore wild lands, build shelters, fight monsters, solve puzzles, and create your unique story. All of this in a multiplayer mode with LAN, P2P, and Steam support.

Survive, build, and fight!

Multiplayer Mode: Play with friends via LAN, P2P, or Steam. Explore the world together, build shelters, gather resources, and fight enemies.

Survival System: Manage health, hunger, thirst, oxygen, and mana. Keep track of your character's state to survive in this harsh world.

Magic and Combat Skills: Unlock powerful magic abilities and combat styles, from one-handed swords to fire magic and throwable bombs. Develop your character with a skill and progression system.

Building System: Build defensive structures, create traps, and enhance your bases with a modular system. Destroy and repair, protecting your creations from external threats.

Animal World: Hunt, raise animals, and create ecosystems. Go fishing, grow plants, and develop your settlement.

Play solo or with friends: Constantly updating mechanics, dynamic combat, and a unique atmosphere will offer an unforgettable adventure for both solo players and teams.

Key features:

  • Multiplayer and network interaction: Full support for LAN, P2P, and Steam. The save and load system allows players to continue their adventure without interruptions.

  • Intuitive controls and character customization: A variety of customization options for appearance and character development. Get inspired by unique combat styles and magic.

  • Variety of combat and weapons: Fight with various weapon types, from long-range guns to magic and improvised tools.

  • Quest and event system: Bring your world to life with advanced quest, dialogue, and journal systems. Develop your story with unique choices and events.

  • Flexible building and destruction system: Create shelters, bases, and traps with a modular system. Protect your territory with locks and mechanical systems.

  • Animals and farming: Tame animals, grow plants, and create stable ecosystems in your world.

Feral Echoes is a game that opens up endless possibilities for exploration, survival, and creativity in a world full of mysteries and dangers. Get ready to fight for survival and create your unique world in this epic adventure!
